breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's flawed instruction to treat the internal torque as uniform over the entire shaft. Instead, it adopted the physically correct approach (also implied by the ground truth prompt) of performing a piecewise analysis. The generated specification correctly identifies two segments and calculates the distinct internal torque for each one before computing stress and twist, thus resolving the inconsistency.
